__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’)
__broaden__.μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱστίον: ’the middle of the sail’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀγκῶνα: ’the middle (of the elbow)’ (ἀγκῶνα … μέσον ’full on the elbow’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun: ’the middle, the space between’ (ἐς μέσον ἀμφοτέρων ’into the space between the two’)

__broaden__.πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl., with πύλαι · also fem. nom. pl. with another fem. noun: ’all’ (πᾶσαι χολάδες ’all the bowels’) · also fem. nom. pl., in apposition to a pronoun: ’all (of them)’ (αἳ … πᾶσαι ’they all’)
